[00:00] HOST: Ines Calder builds narrowboats at a yard in Braunston. Welcome, Ines.
[02:30] INES: We build about six boats a year, each one to order.
[06:10] INES: The steel comes from a mill in Sheffield, cut to size.
[10:45] HOST: What is the longest wait for a customer?
[10:55] INES: Fourteen months, for a boat with a full wooden interior.
[13:20] INES: I always tell people to visit the yard in spring, when the hulls are being painted.
[15:35] HOST: Ines, thank you.
